title: Block It in Blender, Ink It in genAI
hero_prompt: A wide pen-and-ink noir woodcut banner: a jointed wooden artist's mannequin stands staged on a bare studio floor under one canted spotlight, its wire-and-wood armature visible beneath the skin, stark cross-hatched ink shadow beginning to bleed over the wooden form as if the drawing is inking itself into being around the frame. Hand-made pen-and-ink noir woodcut, with visible ink, brush or print texture on paper; flat and graphic, not a photograph, not a 3D render, no depth-of-field, no glossy highlights.
icon_prompt: A bold, high-contrast pen-and-ink icon: a jointed wooden mannequin figure rendered as one solid black silhouette, a single loose brushstroke breaking free from its outline like a gesture line escaping the wire frame.
